note: Source-backed research, product and career signals. These are not verified social-platform virality trends. Scores are editorial estimates for Amit's audience, not measured search volume or engagement forecasts.

candidates.title: AI makes UX work faster. Is it making it better?
candidates.audience_problem: Designers face pressure to use AI, but still need to evaluate output quality, privacy and downstream cleanup.
hooks: AI made UX work faster. Is it making it better?
The hidden cost of AI productivity is verification.
Measure better work, not just faster work.
candidates.evidence_summary: Survey of 521 working UX practitioners. 54% named output quality and 50% data privacy/security as AI adoption barriers; 66% used at least one agentic AI tool. Convenience sample, not a census.

candidates.title: Design files are becoming context for AI agents
candidates.audience_problem: Designers need to make intent, constraints, patterns and quality expectations legible to agents as well as teammates.
hooks: Your design file is becoming context for AI agents.
The next design-system user might be an agent.
Can your design system guide an agent without you?
candidates.evidence_summary: Figma's October 15 updates include code-backed layers, Specs for written context, code sources and guidelines to help agents work with real design systems.

candidates.title: AI UX Designer is an emerging role to watch
candidates.audience_problem: Early-career designers need to understand emerging AI-related design roles and the skills behind them.
hooks: AI UX Designer roles grew 145%. What does that actually mean?
AI UX is not just prompt writing.
Build the judgement behind the tools.
candidates.evidence_summary: AI UX Designer was a new entry with 145% year-over-year growth in Autodesk's Design and Make industries analysis. The figure is not representative of all UX hiring or all geographies.
candidates.freshness: Stale - useful structural signal, not breaking news
